S  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  A.O No.405 of 2023  Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the appellant.

Mr. S.K. Mandal and Mr. Ajeet Kumar Yadav, Advocate for the respondent no.1.
Mr. V.D. Bisen, Additional C.S.C. and Mr. P.S. Bisht, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.

2. On 04.09.2025, this Court directed the District Magistrate, Nainital to hold an enquiry to the effect that, despite after expiry of FSSAI License in October, 2022, packed drinking water was being manufactured and marketed by the respondent no.1.

3. In compliance of the aforesaid order, the District Magistrate constituted a Committee, comprising of S.D.M., Kaladhungi, Senior Food Safety Officer, Food Safety & Drug Administration, District Nainital, besides other officials, who conducted joint investigation, on 16.09.2025.

entities.text: Food Safety & Drug Administration, District Nainital
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Today, learned State Counsel handed over a copy of joint investigation report, which is taken on record.
5. Appellant has also filed a supplementary affidavit, wherein he submitted that respondent no.1 has used the expired license for bottling and marketing the packed drinking water uptill August, 2025.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent no.1 sought two weeks' time to file reply to the supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of appellant.
Objections filed by respondent no.1 are taken on record.

The misc.
applications (I.A. No.3 & 4 of 2023) stand disposed of.
8.
Interim order, if any, to continue till then.

(Alok Mahra, J.) 25.09.2025 Arpan AO/405/2023 on 25 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25008619/
